sharedRules.name: Ion Shield
sharedRules.description:
A model with this special rule has a 4+ Invulnerable save against all Shooting Attacks resolved against its Front Armour Value (FA). In addition, you gain the Rotate Ion Shields Reaction (see below).


Rotate Ion Shields (Reaction): Instead of Setting to Overwatch, this unit may set to Rotate Ion Shields in its Shooting Phase. If you do so, the unit may still shoot in the Shooting Phase, but all attacks made by the unit are resolved as Snap Shots. At the end of your Opponent’s Charge Phase, you may select one of your units Armour Facings (FA/SA/RA). The units 4+ Invulnerable save from the Ion Shields special rule now applies to Shooting Attacks resolved against the chosen Armour Facing.

sharedRules.name: Special Issue Ammunition
sharedRules.description:
A unit with this special rule when firing with an equipped Boltgun, Storm Bolter or Heavy Boltgun, Hurricane Bolter may apply one of the following special ammunition types. All models in the unit must use that same Ammo type during a Shooting Phase.
• Kraken Rounds: The weapons gain the Rending (6+) special rule.
• Dragonfire Rounds: The weapons gain the Ignores Cover special rule.
• Hellfire Rounds: The weapons gain the Poison (4+) special rule this phase.

sharedRules.name: The Aegis
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule gains the Deny the Witch and Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rules. In addition, the unit’s range for Deny the Witch is 24” instead of 18”.

sharedRules.name: Warding Aura
sharedRules.description: A model equipped with a weapon that has this special rule and its attached unit improve their Invulnerable save by 1 to a max of 3+ (i.e 5+ becomes 4+, no invul becomes 6+) if the equipped models unit Remained Stationary in their previous Movement Phase.

sharedRules.name: Ammo Compatible
sharedRules.description: This weapon counts as Boltgun for the purposes of the Special Issue Ammunition special rule.

sharedRules.name: Stasis
sharedRules.description: When a model is hit by a weapon with the Stasis special rule, its Weapon Skill (WS) and Initiative (I) characteristics are reduced by 1 until the start of your next shooting phase.

sharedRules.name: Daemon Weapon
sharedRules.description: You may re-roll all to hit rolls with this weapon but the weapon is treated as having the Gets Hot! Special rule.

sharedRules.name: The Enemy Without
sharedRules.description: All Ordo Xenos units in your army gain the Preferred Enemy (Tyranid, Eldar, T’au, Necron, Votann, Orks) special rule.

sharedRules.name: The Enemy Within
sharedRules.description: All Ordo Hereticus units in your army gain the Zealot special rule.

sharedRules.name: The Enemy Beyond
sharedRules.description: All Ordo Malleus units gain the Preferred Enemy (Chaos) special rule.

rules.name: Boarding Shields
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains a 5+ Invulnerable save. If at least 3 models in a unit are equipped with Boarding Shields, all charges against the equipped unit are treated as Disordered Charges.

rules.name: Xeno-Tech Armoury
rules.description:
If your Warlord has this trait, units in your army may exchange their Boltgun for
• A Shuriken Catapult for 0pts.
• A Splinter Rifle for 1pts.
• A Pulse Rifle for 2pts.
• A Pulse Carbine for 2pts.
• An Ion Blaster for 5pts.
Models in your army may exchange their Power Sword for:
• A Witchblade for 5pts.
• A Dire Sword for 5pts.
• An Agonizer for 10pts.
• A Void Blade for 15pts.
• A Plasma Axe for 10pts.

rules.name: Master of Interrogation
rules.description: If your army includes a model with this Warlord trait, your opponent may not deploy models via the Infiltration special rule during the deployment step and suffers -1 to all rolls when determining if a unit will arrive via Outflank.

rules.name: Sanctic Will
rules.description: Your Warlord and any attached unit gain the Stubborn and Indomitable Spirit (2+) special rules.

rules.name: Plate Armour
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 3+ Armor save but cannot perform Sweeping Advances.

rules.name: Buckler Shield
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains +1 to its Armor save in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Castellan of the Black Vault
rules.description: If your Warlord has this trait, All “Black Shield” models and units with the Character special rule in your army gain the Master-Crafted special rule on all weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Paragon of their Chapter
rules.description:
If this unit is your warlord, you gain one of the following (selected when mustering your army)
• Your Warlord always counts as holding an Objective regardless of the number of enemy models contesting it.
• Gain the Skilled Rider special rule.
• Your Warlord may re-roll hit rolls of 1 with “Bolt” and “Chain” weapons.
• Your Warlord gains the Night Vision special rule.
• Your Warlord gains the Zealot special rule.
• Your Warlord gains the Rage special rule.
• Your Warlord gains the Relentless special rule.
• Your Warlord gains the Fire & Fade special rule.
• Your Warlord gains +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic.
• Your Warlord gains the Skirmisher special rule.

rules.name: The Ties that Bind
rules.description: All models in your army gain +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.

rules.name: Psychic Epitome
rules.description:
Increase the Warlords Psyker (x) special rule by 1 to a max of 3. In
addition, they may re-roll 1 dice when performing a Psychic test when attempting to activate the Force special rule.

rules.name: Slayer of the Darkness
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait gains the Monster Hunter and Tank Hunter special rules.

rules.name: Nemesis Lord
rules.description: Your Warlord gains the Precision Hits special rule on all Melee weapons they are equipped with. In addition, your Warlord gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic.

rules.name: Daemon Slayer
rules.description: Your Warlord gains the Monster Hunter and Hatred (Daemons) special rules.

rules.name: Crown of Kings
rules.description: All House Guard units that can visibility to a Warlord with this trait may re-roll Pinning and Panic tests.

rules.name: Throne of Ancestors
rules.description: A model with this trait, at the start of each phase, select 1 weapon they are equipped with that was Destroyed as a result of a Weapon Destroyed result. That weapon counts as not being Destroyed and may be used but counts as having the Gets Hot! Special rule until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Vortex of Doom
rules.description: When this power is cast, place 1 Vortex Marker within 12” of the Psyker. A Vortex Marker should be no larger than a 25mm Base. Only 1 Vortex of Doom can be cast at once. If another unit attempts to Cast this Psychic Power, the previous Vortex Marker is removed and a new once is placed down. If a Vortex marker has been placed down already, a unit that knows this Psychic Power can attempt to cast this Psychic Power again to either place a new Vortex marker or move the existing Marker 2D6”. All units that end their Movement Phase within 6” of the Vortex marker take D6, Strength 10, AP1 automatic hits.

rules.name: Gate of Infinity
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit are removed from the Battlefield. The unit may then be placed anywhere back on the Battlefield more than 9” away from any enemy models. A unit which performs this Psychic Power and its attached unit this turn, may not declare a Charge in the Charge Phase.

rules.name: Banishment
rules.description: When this power is cast, Select 1 enemy unit within 12” the Psyker with the Daemon special rule. That unit has -1 to its invulnerable Saves until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Sanctuary
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and al friendly units within 12” gain a 6+ Invulnerable Save. Any unit that already has an Invulnerable Save gain +1 to their Invulnerable Save (to a Max of 3+). This lasts until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Mantle of Shadow
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit cannot be targeted for Shooting Attacks in your opponents Shooting Phase unless they are the closest visible enemy unit. This lasts until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Psychic Cleanse
rules.description: When this power is cast, all enemy units within 6” of the Psyker take 2D6 automatic hits resolved at Strength 4, AP4 with the Deflagrate special rule.

rules.name: Fortified With Contempt
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Feel No Pain (6+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Neural Void
rules.description: When this power is cast, enemy units within 3” of the Psyker or their attached unit halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Severance
rules.description: When this power is cast, enemy model in an enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. The target enemy model’s Leadership (LD) characteristic may not be used for Leadership tests that unit is called to make until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: The Book of Emperor Ascendant
rules.description: Friendly units within 12” of a model bearing this Relic gain +1 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic. Once per game, the equipped model may open the book in their Shooting Phase. Select 1 enemy unit within 12” to take D3+2, Strength 14, AP1 Automatic hits.
